thesis: The thesis still holds. SIBN re-rated after Q3 earnings (revenue +14.5% YoY, loss narrowed to 3.62M, cash 146.26M vs debt 42.80M), is in an uptrend (24.59 above SMA20 23.49, SMA50 21.00, rs_63 +0.34), and Healthcare is one of only three sectors above its 50-day in a 0.95-confidence risk-off tape. The problem is the entry. Price ran to 24.59, 0.79 above the top of the morning 23.2-23.8 zone. With the stop unchanged at 22.55 and the target at the 25.92 52-week high, R/R is about 0.65 at the last price and only about 1.25 at the 24.05 midpoint of the technical card's raised 23.85-24.25 zone. Both are below 1.5, so this drops to Hold (lessons item 3) until price pulls back into the zone or breaks above 25.92 on volume.
invalidation: A daily close below 22.55 (under the 22.72 swing low of 2026-11-18) breaks the pullback structure.
key_risks: Entry ran away: R/R at 24.59 is about 0.65 (1.33 reward vs 2.04 risk), and the stock is up 3.6% today from the 23.73 prior close
Broad risk-off regime (QQQ 21-day -13.63%, VIX 31.34 at the 0.991 1-year percentile) can drag the stock down with the market
25.92 is the post-earnings high and a supply zone, and the analyst mean target of about 26.78 leaves limited upside
Short interest of 11.7% of float and about 0.71M average volume can amplify moves and gap through the stop
Still loss-making, and revenue dipped slightly quarter on quarter (56.01M to 55.70M)
Correlated healthcare exposure with other healthcare names (lessons item 8)
Correction to the morning card: the packet shows tax-withholding sales by the legal chief and one other officer on 2026-11-18. No CEO sale appears in the packet
